French Language and Culture

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

Study French language, literature and culture, including linguistics, French-speaking societies and the history of France. The degree develops advanced spoken and written French and academic research skills.

The published requirements do not yet establish a complete curriculum for a reliable programme comparison. The supported components are shown below; UCR alternatives are withheld.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: French specialisation: supported components only

The degree is 180 EC. This list accounts for 165 distinct EC because three courses appear in both the first- and second-year requirements. Clarification is needed about the remaining 15 EC. This is a partial list, not a complete degree pathway.

Official programme source ↗
